rows.en: Ai: "...So, with that settled, isn't it about time we chose a leader?"
Touya: "Wh-What?! Where did that come from?
And... what's 'settled,' exactly?"
Ai: "Oh, let's skip the nitpicking.
If we don't get this sort of thing decided properly,
it'll get complicated later.
So we're deciding now. Got it?"
Touya: "Hey, come on... Hmm?"
Yamato: 'Maybe Ai's trying to show everyone she's feeling better,
so they won't worry?'
Touya: 'Huh...? Y-Yeah, maybe.'
Yamato: 'Let's go along with her suggestion, okay?'
Touya: 'Yeah.'
Ai: "Hey, you two! What's with the
whispering?
We're choosing a leader now. Okay?"
Touya: "Yeah, fine.
...So who's going to do it?
Clovis, I guess...?"
Clovis: "I'm not cut out for that.
Besides, that sort of nuisance is Arthur's job."
Arthur: "Me?"
Ai: "Oh, no, no. You're the kind who belongs in the number-two spot,
where your character really shines! If someone like that becomes the leader,
you can bet they'll die halfway through the story!"
Arthur: "O-Oh. Is that how it works...?"
Clovis: "Then who's right for the job?"
Ai: "Hmm... Leadership, personal character, piloting skill...
Taking all that into account..."
Fain: "Me?"
Ai: "Little Ai puuunch!"
Fain: "Wh-What are you doing?!"
Ai: "You're obviously the charge-ahead type!
A leader should be, you know... cool-headed,
but with a burning spirit inside..."
Touya: "So who is it?"
Ai: "Me! M-E!
Besides, you and I are the only ones left, aren't we?"
Fain: "..."
Ai: "Wh-What?! Got a problem with that?!"
Arthur: "Personally, I think Touya would be the right choice..."
Touya: "Huh?!"
Ai & Fain: "Whaaat?!"
Touya: "What?! You got a problem with me?!"
Ai: "If it's Touya, we might as well have Fain."
Fain: "What do you mean, 'might as well'?!"
Celica: "Hmm... Touya really has grown
at an amazing rate, and as far as potential goes,
there's nothing to complain about, is there?"
Ymir: "And Touya has been giving
the orders all this time. I think he's the right choice too."
Ai: "Aww... Even you, Ymir...?"
Fain: "Th-That's right!
To think you'd say that, Ymir..."
Arthur: "Ai, Fain. A word."
Ai: "What?"
Arthur: "Just come here a moment."
Fain: "What is it? Why all this...?"
Arthur: 'Being the leader isn't all good, you know.
If you only look at commanding battles,
it may seem impressive,
but in practice, you have to plan operations, give orders...
There must be plenty of troublesome work too.'
Touya: "Hey, what are you whispering about over there?"
Ai: "...Touya, good luck."
Fain: "Heh... I'm leaving it to you."
Touya: "Hey, come on... Well, if you insist..."
Clovis: "Then it's settled."
Ymir: "Heh heh... Do your best, Touya."
Touya: "Yeah! You can count on me!"
Garyud: "That's the spirit. Very reassuring."
Ciel: "...Father, once we reach the Holy Land,
what do you intend to do?"
Garyud: "Once the future of Liebhofen and the Spirit Mechs
has been decided, I'll return to York."
Fain: "Huh?! Y-You won't
fight alongside us?!"
Garyud: "No. Even if we call ourselves neutral,
we cannot earn trust if one particular nation is backing us.
Besides, something about Zigrim's large-scale invasion
bothers me. If we shake things up,
we may see what's hidden behind it."
Fain: "B-But...!"
Celica: "Did you have everyone gather at the abandoned Krondem mine
for that reason?"
Garyud: "Yes. We cannot leave our homeland
in the invaders' hands forever.
And I want to lay Her Majesty to rest in the land of her birth."
Fain: "..."
Ymir: "...I see. If you've thought it through that far,
we have no right to tell you what to do.
But without the people of York, the Spirit Mech Development Project
would never have been possible.
Please remember that if there's anything we can do,
we will help."
Garyud: "Thank you for your consideration. In any case,
that's for after we reach the Holy Land. I'll be in your care a little longer."
Ymir: "Of course."
Celica: "We're nearly at the Holy Land."
Touya: "I've been wondering for a while...
What exactly is this 'Holy Land'?"
Celica: "Huh? Nobody told you?
Hmm... Ymir, could you explain?"
Ymir: "Huh? Explain the Holy Land? ...Well... To put it simply,
it's the collective name for Alchemist training and research institutions in this world of Agarthia.
Does that make sense?"
Touya: "Not at all."
Ymir: "Well, Touya, the people called 'scientists' in your world
are called 'Alchemists'
here.
It's their school,
their laboratory, their workshop... Their central institution.
It was originally founded to prevent the misuse of alchemy,
with the aim of 'cooperating for the sound development of technology.'
It's free from the influence of any national government,
an inviolable sanctuary where every nation is forbidden to use force.
That is the 'Holy Land.'"
Touya: "Huh. Then why is it inside the Kingdom of Agarthia's
territory?"
Ymir: "It wasn't that way originally.
As the Kingdom of Agarthia expanded its territory,
things took their present form.
You could even call it the smallest independent nation
on the continent."
Touya: "There must be some reason a place like that
gets treated as an inviolable sanctuary, right?"
Celica: "Oh, you're surprisingly sharp."
Touya: "You can leave out the 'surprisingly.'"
Celica: "Ha ha, sorry, sorry.
Well, the Holy Land is also a center of cutting-edge Armored Mech
development research.
In other words, controlling it would mean acquiring all the technology for Armored Mech
construction. If you wanted to unify the world
by force, it'd be the perfect target."
Touya: "Then all the more reason... Oh."
Celica: "Exactly. The surrounding nations wouldn't just sit by
and let that happen, would they? They kept each other in check, and eventually reached an agreement.
That's how it became 'inviolable.'"
Fain: "Besides, Rayblade is in the Holy Land.
If the Holy Land is in danger, it'll shine like this... Flash!
Then boom, out it comes! I'm sure of it."
Touya: "You're 'sure'? So you're just guessing.
Huh...? By the way, what's this Rayblade?"
Celica: "It's the mech that served as the basis
for the Spirit Mechs you're piloting. Well, since it was discovered 29 years ago,
it hasn't moved once. But 109 years ago,
records say it stood against the ≪Ze=Ode≫ single-handedly,
so its power is said to be equal to theirs,
or even greater."
Touya: "But if it doesn't move, it's no use, is it...?"
Celica: "Well, yes. And it's been sealed away,
so now we can't even investigate it.
We were really lucky to get the data before that."
Touya: "...What do you mean?"
Celica: "Heh heh heh... That's a secret."
Touya: "You..."
Ymir: "Celica obtained it by hacking."
Arthur: "Huh?! Is that what happened?"
Celica: "Huh? Didn't I tell you?"
Ymir: "It should have been a huge scandal, but by the time we realized,
she'd already made us accomplices... Who could have imagined
she'd used that data in the prototypes?"
Celica: "But if I hadn't,
they still wouldn't be finished even now."
Ymir: "That's true, but...
You caused Lady Ivel and Prince Lodis
so much trouble..."
Touya: "...Now that's one outrageous princess."
Celica: "Ehehehehe..."
Fain: "Come to think of it, you said there were new Spirit Mechs in the Holy Land,
didn't you?"
Ymir: "Yes. The close-combat Spirit Mech Dusseldorf
and the air-support type Forstin should have finished
their final adjustments, but..."
Fain: "The princess showed me images before,
so that mech called Dusseldorf is complete, correct?"
Celica: "Of course. It should be ready to move right now."
Fain: "I see... Right now... Heh heh heh..."
Celica: "Hey, Fain?
You're not thinking anything strange, are you?!"
Fain: "O-Of course not! I haven't the slightest thought
of jumping in and piloting it at the first opportunity!"
Touya: "..."
Touya: "What's this...? The crystal's... ringing...?"
Ymir: "Hmm? Is something wrong?"
Touya: "Huh? You can't hear it?"
Celica: "What? What can you hear?"
Touya: "It's this..."
Touya: "Oh, it stopped..."
Ai: "That's... what Alforina gave you..."
Ymir: "The Resonance Crystal... How did you get that?"
Touya: "Oh, right. You'd stepped out at the time, hadn't you?
Queen Alforina told me it would guide us in the right direction,
and gave it to me.
I meant to return it properly, but then all that happened..."
Ymir: "I-I see... Perhaps Lady Alforina foresaw
that things would turn out this way..."
Ai: "...Maybe... She said she had the power
to have precognitive dreams, though they were vague...
But if she knew, then why...?"
Arthur: "That's the kind of person she was, wasn't it?
She'd try to save more people rather than just save herself...
You know that better than anyone, Ai."
Ai: "That's true... But..."
Clovis: "Does that crystal have some
important significance?"
Ymir: "This... The Resonance Crystal is the key to releasing the seal that's on Rayblade
right now."
Arthur: "I see. So without that crystal,
Rayblade's seal can't be released.
And Rayblade is in the Holy Land, while the key is in York..."
Touya: "Why go to all that trouble?"
Arthur: "Because you had no intention of using Rayblade,
is that right?"
Ymir: "Yes. This way, nobody could touch it.
Besides, the Istarsh royal family has deep ties with the Holy Land,
and both the previous queen and Queen Alforina were
people we could trust.
That's why we asked them to cooperate
with the sealing. In other words, York was also responsible for Rayblade's
protection."
Touya: "Is Rayblade that dangerous?"
Ymir: "Rayblade itself isn't dangerous.
But its power is unknown, and to protect it
from those who would exploit it, we put up a barrier that absorbs Prana radiation.
The Frail Barrier was used
to seal Rayblade away. Even now, though, people keep trying
to obtain information about it."
Miyasco: "We'll reach the Holy Land shortly. ...Oh!"
Ymir: "What's wrong?"
Miyasco: "The Holy Land... The Holy Land's under attack!"
Celica: "What?! Which country is it?!
Are they trying to make enemies of the entire world?!"
Miyasco: "Oh, I've got it... Huh? This is...
There's no matching data!"
Celica: "...Then it's a new model?"
Touya: "Anyway, we can't just sit by and watch, can we?
Let's go help them!"
Arthur: "Agreed.
Let's hurry and prepare to launch!"
Celica: "Oh, I'm sure you know this already,
but you're staying aboard this time too."
Fain: "Yes. I understand. Heh heh heh..."
Celica: "...He doesn't understand at all."
